turns.question: Aur CG quota ke liye?
turns.query: What is the admission basis for the Chhattisgarh quota for B.Tech programmes at IIIT Naya Raipur in 2026?
turns.answer: CG quota ke liye admission JEE Main 2026 rank ke basis par hota hai, aur candidates ko Chhattisgarh ke school se 10th‑12th pass hona, 12th mein PCM ka 50% aggregate (SC/ST/OBC‑NCL/PwD ke liye 45%) aur date of birth criteria (Oct‑01‑2000, SC/ST/OBC‑NCL/PwD ke liye Oct‑01‑1997 tak) poora karna zaroori hai.

sources.quote: Admission to the B.Tech. programmes at IIIT Naya Raipur is governed solely by the JEE (Main) 2026 rank.

Candidates must pass the 10th and 12th standard examinations from the
schools in the State of Chhattisgarh only.
2.Candidates must have scored 50% aggregate marks in Chemistry, Physics and
Mathematics (45% for SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwD candidates) in their 12th
standard examination.

Candidates’ date of birth must be on or after October 01, 2000. For the candidates belonging to SC, ST, OBC-NCL and PwD, the upper age limit is relaxable by three years, i.e. SC, ST, OBC-NCL, and PwD candidates’ date of birth must be on or after October 01, 1997.
